We have 3 bottles, each containing a certain amount of water.
  • If we pour 150 cl of water from bottle A to bottle B, B would have 4 times of water as in A.
  • If we pour 48 cl of water from bottle B to bottle C, C would have 3 times of water as in B.
  • If we pour 30 cl of water from bottle C to bottle A, A would have the same amount of water as C.
How much water there is in each bottle (in centiliters)?
